title: Optimize `Object::get_script` and refactor internal usage to avoid Refs

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Optimize `Object::get_script()`
- Code style/performance improvement to call-sites of `Object::get_script()`
- Follow up to #123810

## Additional information

`Object::get_script` currently has an extra set of ref/unref. When used as a temporary, this is a total of two pairs of refs and unrefs.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/084a2caa05119b625a99b6b51d44b459a26362de/core/object/object.cpp#L1089-L1091

Instead of constructing a temporary `Ref` and then using `Ref::operator Variant()`, we use the `Variant(const Object *)` constructor which still increments ref count.

```diff
Variant Object::get_script() const {
-	return script_instance ? Variant(Ref<Script>(script_instance->get_script())) : Variant();
+ 	return script_instance ? Variant(script_instance->get_script()) : Variant();
}
```

Yet even with these changes the following common pattern still results in two pairs of ref/unrefs. One for the Variant temporary and one for the local Ref variable. 

```cpp
Ref<Script> script = obj->get_script();
```

With #123810, the above pattern can already be done with no refs.

```cpp
Script *script = obj->get_script_instance() != nullptr ? obj->get_script_instance()->get_script() : nullptr;
```

The above snippet is the new `Object::get_script()` as this is used extensively internally. The old Variant version is binded as a new function.

This PR updates about two-thirds of call-sites of `Object::get_script()` to not use a Ref. The remaining third has been changed to call the new optimized `Object::get_script_bind()` instead (same functionality as the old `get_script`).

## Organization of Changes

Starting with the Object API changes:

* `core/object/object.h`
* `core/object/object.cpp`

The changes from #123810 have been updated to use the new helper

* `core/variant/container_type_validate.cpp`
* `modules/gdscript/gdscript_function.cpp`

The rest are a blanket update of `get_script` calls that do not need a Ref. The ones that cannot change to the `Script *` version have been updated to call the bind version instead.

## Benchmarks

<details>
<summary>Code</summary>

```gdscript
class_name A extends Object

var x: A
```

```gdscript
func _on_json_button_pressed() -> void:
	var a : Array
	
	for i in 20:
		a.push_back(A.new())
	
	var start = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	
	for i in 50_000:
		JSON.from_native(a, true)
	
	print(Time.get_ticks_msec() - start)


func _on_get_script_button_pressed() -> void:
	var a = A.new()
	
	var start = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	
	for i in 10_000_000:
		a.get_script()
	
	print(Time.get_ticks_msec() - start)
```

Note: the JSON benchmark is normalized per object in the array. Calculated as t / 20 / 50,000 * 10e9.
</details>

Run 21 times on release templates and 10th percentile is summarized below.

| Function | Master (ns/op) | PR (ns/op) | Diff | Speedup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| JSON.from_native() | 840 | 773 | 67 | 1.09x |
| Object.get_script() | 62.5 | 45.4 | 17.1 | 1.38x |
